items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: I'd teach him what the professor taught me. So Eddie calls me Professor today.

ctx.x: Oh I've heard of him. What was his name, Santo?

Santo Giuffre. He was a very, very fine musician, very good teacher. And Eddie Miller and I started together and Eddie was always broke. So I'd go take a lesson and Eddie would meet me at my house and I'd teach him what the professor taught me. So Eddie calls me Professor today.
That's funny. So he's about your age?
